'''Edge''', designated '''CT-9538''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]].

==Biography==
Edge, along with the rest of Tango Company, served on Geonosis, and was afterward sent on a medical supply run to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. He served aboard a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] that was under the command of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. He was infected with one of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]] that had stowed aboard the ship, and was subsequently mind-controlled and forced to take over the ship. He also helped clone trooper [[Ox/Legends|Ox]] under the orders of [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] to clear the bridge of the clone [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. He then attacked the Jedi in the dining room, but he and Ox were knocked unconscious. Later, he and Scythe pinned down the final uninfected clone trooper on the ship and infected him with the brain worm. When Offee tried to reach the bridge, Edge shocked her as she walked through. But Edge, along with the rest of the crew, was sterilized when Ahsoka ruptured the cooling tanks.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

==Personality and traits==
Unlike most clone troopers who had brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Edge had pale blue eyes due to a stray mutation.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Equipment==
Edge had the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Senth/Legends|Senth]] tattooed above his left eye. He carried a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], and a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]. He as well wore a backpack. He wore Phase I Armor that had blue markings and bore a small striped sigil on his right breastplate that resembled a stylized tiger face.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />
